BiblicalUsage: Yebal is the Aramaic word for bringing, for carrying something to its place. Cyrus took the vessels of gold and silver out of the temple of Babylon, and commanded that they be brought again to the temple in Jerusalem, every one to his place.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God brings back what was taken, and the vessels of His house return to their place.
